name: Jikkyou Namahame Ero Yakyuu
original_name: 実況ナマハメエロ野球
source:
This is a parody game of Konami's baseball game Power Pros, but it was threatened to sue by Konami and the sale was discontinued.

The protagonist, who is plunged into the depths of despair after learning that he is not included in the team's roster for next season, is helped by the first female pitcher in Japanese baseball history! 

"Let's work hard on special training so you don't get cut!" 

But somehow their training takes an erotic turn...

[Edited from the official website]
